name: Active Cut Management
aliases: Active Cut Management with Merge/Split Queues
View-dependent hierarchical LOD for volume rendering
definition: The active cut is a set of nodes whose cells cover the model space in its entirety exactly once. It is maintained from frame to frame to balance visual quality and frame time.
summary: Active Cut Management is a view-dependent level-of-detail technique that dynamically maintains an octree active cut via merge and split operations to balance visual fidelity against frame time and memory constraints.
